title: Two Halves, Mutably
goal: Split a mutable slice into two halves and modify both without borrow conflicts.
hints: Indexing `arr` twice creates overlapping mutable borrows.
Use `split_at_mut` to divide a mutable slice into two separate mutable slices.
explanation: Writing `(&mut arr[..mid], &mut arr[mid..])` directly fails with `E0499` because range indexing borrows `arr` mutably twice. `split_at_mut(mid)` safely partitions a single mutable reference into two non-overlapping sub-slices. `split_at(mid)` returns immutable slices, causing `E0596` when attempting mutation. Using `right.len()` panics at runtime from an out-of-bounds index.
